# Selektable

## Docs

- [Authentication](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/authentication.md): Authenticate API requests with a Bearer token
- [Create a generation](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/generations/create.md): Starts an asynchronous AI visualization. Returns `202 Accepted` with a `processing` generation. Supply an `Idempotency-Key` header to safely retry.
- [List generations](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/generations/list.md): Cursor-paginated, newest first.
- [Retrieve a generation](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/generations/retrieve.md): Poll this endpoint to track status when not using webhooks.
- [Create a webhook endpoint](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/webhook-endpoints/create.md): Registers an HTTPS endpoint to receive signed events. The signing `secret` is returned ONCE in this response and never again.
- [Delete a webhook endpoint](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/webhook-endpoints/delete.md)
- [List webhook endpoints](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/webhook-endpoints/list.md)
- [Retrieve a webhook endpoint](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/webhook-endpoints/retrieve.md)
- [Update a webhook endpoint](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/endpoints/webhook-endpoints/update.md)
- [Errors](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/errors.md): Error envelope, status codes, and what each one means
- [Idempotency](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/idempotency.md): Safely retry generation requests without creating duplicates
- [API introduction](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/introduction.md): Generate AI product visualizations over a REST API
- [Rate limits](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/rate-limits.md): Per-key request limits and how to back off
- [Webhooks](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/webhooks.md): Receive signed events when generations complete or fail
- [Analytics events](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/analytics-events.md): Listen to widget events to feed your own analytics tools
- [Cart integration](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/cart-integration.md): Let customers add products to their cart from the visualization
- [Conversion tracking](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/conversion-tracking.md): Track purchases and leads to measure the impact of widget visualizations
- [Custom store setup](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/custom-store.md): Complete guide to setting up a custom store with Selektable
- [Identity tracking](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/identity-tracking.md): Associate visualizations with customer identities across sessions
- [Localization](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/localization.md): Multi-language support for Selektable widgets
- [Choosing the right product image](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/product-image.md): How to select the best product image for AI generation
- [Widgets](https://docs.selektable.com/guides/widgets.md): Configuring and managing Selektable widgets
- [How it works](https://docs.selektable.com/how-it-works.md): Understanding the Selektable visualization pipeline
- [Custom platform](https://docs.selektable.com/integrations/custom-platform.md): Integrate Selektable with any custom ecommerce platform
- [Shopify](https://docs.selektable.com/integrations/shopify.md): Integrate Selektable with your Shopify store
- [WooCommerce](https://docs.selektable.com/integrations/woocommerce.md): Integrate Selektable with your WooCommerce store
- [Introduction](https://docs.selektable.com/introduction.md): AI-powered product visualization for ecommerce
- [Quickstart](https://docs.selektable.com/quickstart.md): Get your first Selektable widget running in minutes
- [Events](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/events.md): PostMessage events between the widget and your page
- [Advanced examples](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/examples/advanced.md): Advanced integration patterns for the Selektable SDK
- [Basic usage](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/examples/basic-usage.md): Simple examples to get started with the Selektable SDK
- [Cart integration examples](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/examples/cart-integration.md): Examples for integrating add-to-cart functionality
- [Multi-Product visualization](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/examples/multi-product.md): Visualize multiple products together in a single scene
- [Identity](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/identity.md): SDK methods for managing customer identity
- [Installation](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/installation.md): How to install the Selektable embed script
- [Methods](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/methods.md): Complete reference for all Selektable SDK methods
- [SDK overview](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/overview.md): Introduction to the Selektable client SDK
- [Product options](https://docs.selektable.com/sdk/product-options.md): Full reference for the ProductOptions object passed to Selektable.open()

## OpenAPI Specs

- [openapi](https://docs.selektable.com/api-reference/openapi.json)
